avatar_frame_ready_check.name: avatar_frame_ready_check
avatar_frame_ready_check.value:
(NOT "avatar_frame"."active" OR "avatar_frame"."asset_key" IS NOT NULL) AND (
      ("avatar_frame"."asset_key" IS NULL AND num_nonnulls("avatar_frame"."preview_key", "avatar_frame"."width", "avatar_frame"."height", "avatar_frame"."frame_count", "avatar_frame"."byte_size", "avatar_frame"."preview_byte_size", "avatar_frame"."sha256", "avatar_frame"."preview_sha256", "avatar_frame"."source_sha256", "avatar_frame"."delays", "avatar_frame"."loop") = 0)
      OR ("avatar_frame"."asset_key" IS NOT NULL AND "avatar_frame"."preview_key" IS NOT NULL
        AND num_nonnulls("avatar_frame"."preview_key", "avatar_frame"."width", "avatar_frame"."height", "avatar_frame"."frame_count", "avatar_frame"."byte_size", "avatar_frame"."preview_byte_size", "avatar_frame"."sha256", "avatar_frame"."preview_sha256", "avatar_frame"."source_sha256", "avatar_frame"."delays") = 10
        AND "avatar_frame"."width" BETWEEN 1 AND 318 AND "avatar_frame"."height" BETWEEN 1 AND 318
        AND "avatar_frame"."frame_count" BETWEEN 1 AND 120
        AND "avatar_frame"."byte_size" BETWEEN 1 AND CASE WHEN "avatar_frame"."frame_count" > 1 THEN 5242880 ELSE 2000000 END
        AND "avatar_frame"."preview_byte_size" BETWEEN 1 AND 2000000
        AND "avatar_frame"."sha256" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND "avatar_frame"."preview_sha256" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND "avatar_frame"."source_sha256" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
        AND "avatar_frame"."delays" IS NOT NULL)
    )

generated.as: CASE WHEN "chapter"."number" IS NULL OR ("chapter"."numbering_mode" = 'volume' AND "chapter"."volume_id" IS NULL) THEN 'id:' || "chapter"."id"::text WHEN "chapter"."numbering_mode" = 'volume' THEN 'v:' || "chapter"."volume_id"::text || ':' || "chapter"."number"::text ELSE 'n:' || "chapter"."number"::text END

chapter_replica_discovery_idx.name: chapter_replica_discovery_idx
chapter_replica_discovery_idx.where: "chapter"."pages_version" > 0 AND "chapter"."publication_state" = 'published' AND "chapter"."moderation_hidden_at" IS NULL AND "chapter"."deleted_at" IS NULL

chapter_delete_metadata_check.name: chapter_delete_metadata_check
chapter_delete_metadata_check.value: "chapter"."deleted_at" IS NOT NULL OR ("chapter"."deleted_by_user_id" IS NULL AND "chapter"."delete_reason" IS NULL)

chapter_page_optimized_dimensions_check.name: chapter_page_optimized_dimensions_check
chapter_page_optimized_dimensions_check.value: ("chapter_page"."optimized_width" IS NULL AND "chapter_page"."optimized_height" IS NULL) OR ("chapter_page"."optimized_width" > 0 AND "chapter_page"."optimized_height" > 0)

chapter_tiktok_replica_claim_check.name: chapter_tiktok_replica_claim_check
chapter_tiktok_replica_claim_check.value: ("chapter_tiktok_replica"."state" = 'running') = ("chapter_tiktok_replica"."claim_token" IS NOT NULL AND "chapter_tiktok_replica"."claim_expires_at" IS NOT NULL)

chapter_upload_page_key_check.name: chapter_upload_page_key_check
chapter_upload_page_key_check.value: ("chapter_upload_page"."staging_key" IS NOT NULL AND "chapter_upload_page"."published_original_key" IS NULL) OR ("chapter_upload_page"."staging_key" IS NULL AND "chapter_upload_page"."published_original_key" IS NOT NULL)

chapter_upload_page_metadata_check.name: chapter_upload_page_metadata_check
chapter_upload_page_metadata_check.value: "chapter_upload_page"."state" <> 'ready' OR ("chapter_upload_page"."width" > 0 AND "chapter_upload_page"."height" > 0 AND ("chapter_upload_page"."published_original_key" IS NOT NULL OR ("chapter_upload_page"."source_byte_size" > 0 AND "chapter_upload_page"."stored_byte_size" > 0 AND "chapter_upload_page"."sha256" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')))

chapter_upload_page_published_optimized_.name: chapter_upload_page_published_optimized_check
chapter_upload_page_published_optimized_.value: ("chapter_upload_page"."published_optimized_key" IS NULL OR ("chapter_upload_page"."published_original_key" IS NOT NULL AND "chapter_upload_page"."published_optimized_key" <> '' AND "chapter_upload_page"."published_optimized_key" !~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*://' AND "chapter_upload_page"."published_optimized_key" !~ '^/')) AND (("chapter_upload_page"."published_optimized_width" IS NULL AND "chapter_upload_page"."published_optimized_height" IS NULL) OR ("chapter_upload_page"."published_original_key" IS NOT NULL AND "chapter_upload_page"."published_optimized_width" > 0 AND "chapter_upload_page"."published_optimized_height" > 0))

chapter_upload_session_version_check.name: chapter_upload_session_version_check
chapter_upload_session_version_check.value: ("chapter_upload_session"."chapter_id" IS NULL AND "chapter_upload_session"."mode" = 'initial' AND "chapter_upload_session"."expected_chapter_version" IS NULL) OR ("chapter_upload_session"."chapter_id" IS NOT NULL AND "chapter_upload_session"."expected_chapter_version" > 0)

comment_creation_receipt_check.name: comment_creation_receipt_check
comment_creation_receipt_check.value: ("comment"."creation_key" IS NULL AND "comment"."creation_fingerprint" IS NULL) OR ("comment"."creation_key" IS NOT NULL AND "comment"."creation_fingerprint" IS NOT NULL AND "comment"."creation_fingerprint" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')

comment_delete_metadata_check.name: comment_delete_metadata_check
comment_delete_metadata_check.value: "comment"."deleted_at" IS NOT NULL OR ("comment"."deleted_by_user_id" IS NULL AND "comment"."delete_reason" IS NULL)

cover_dimensions_check.name: cover_dimensions_check
cover_dimensions_check.value: ("cover"."width" IS NULL AND "cover"."height" IS NULL) OR ("cover"."width" > 0 AND "cover"."height" > 0)

cover_upload_operation_keys_check.name: cover_upload_operation_keys_check
cover_upload_operation_keys_check.value: "cover_upload_operation"."original_key" <> '' AND "cover_upload_operation"."medium_key" <> '' AND "cover_upload_operation"."small_key" <> '' AND "cover_upload_operation"."original_key" !~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*://' AND "cover_upload_operation"."medium_key" !~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*://' AND "cover_upload_operation"."small_key" !~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*://' AND "cover_upload_operation"."original_key" !~ '^/' AND "cover_upload_operation"."medium_key" !~ '^/' AND "cover_upload_operation"."small_key" !~ '^/'

cover_upload_session_keys_check.name: cover_upload_session_keys_check
cover_upload_session_keys_check.value: "cover_upload_session"."original_staging_key" <> '' AND "cover_upload_session"."medium_staging_key" <> '' AND "cover_upload_session"."small_staging_key" <> '' AND "cover_upload_session"."original_staging_key" !~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*://' AND "cover_upload_session"."medium_staging_key" !~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*://' AND "cover_upload_session"."small_staging_key" !~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*://' AND "cover_upload_session"."original_staging_key" !~ '^/' AND "cover_upload_session"."medium_staging_key" !~ '^/' AND "cover_upload_session"."small_staging_key" !~ '^/'

manga_delete_metadata_check.name: manga_delete_metadata_check
manga_delete_metadata_check.value: "manga"."deleted_at" IS NOT NULL OR ("manga"."deleted_by_user_id" IS NULL AND "manga"."delete_reason" IS NULL)

manga_volume_delete_metadata_check.name: manga_volume_delete_metadata_check
manga_volume_delete_metadata_check.value: "manga_volume"."deleted_at" IS NOT NULL OR ("manga_volume"."deleted_by_user_id" IS NULL AND "manga_volume"."delete_reason" IS NULL)

notification_target_check.name: notification_target_check
notification_target_check.value: ("notification"."type" = 'manga_new_chapter' AND "notification"."manga_id" IS NOT NULL AND "notification"."chapter_id" IS NOT NULL AND "notification"."group_id" IS NULL) OR ("notification"."type" <> 'manga_new_chapter' AND "notification"."manga_id" IS NULL AND "notification"."chapter_id" IS NULL AND "notification"."group_id" IS NOT NULL)

shop_chest_lifecycle_check.name: shop_chest_lifecycle_check
shop_chest_lifecycle_check.value:
("shop_chest"."kind" = 'common' AND "shop_chest"."topic_id" IS NULL AND "shop_chest"."topic_name" IS NULL AND "shop_chest"."retired_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("shop_chest"."kind" = 'topic' AND "shop_chest"."topic_name" IS NOT NULL
          AND length(btrim("shop_chest"."topic_name")) BETWEEN 1 AND 160
          AND (("shop_chest"."topic_id" IS NOT NULL AND "shop_chest"."retired_at" IS NULL)
            OR ("shop_chest"."topic_id" IS NULL AND "shop_chest"."retired_at" IS NOT NULL AND NOT "shop_chest"."sale_enabled")))

shop_gacha_roll_chest_check.name: shop_gacha_roll_chest_check
shop_gacha_roll_chest_check.value:
"shop_gacha_roll"."chest_version" > 0 AND length(btrim("shop_gacha_roll"."chest_name")) BETWEEN 1 AND 180
        AND (("shop_gacha_roll"."chest_kind" = 'common' AND "shop_gacha_roll"."topic_id" IS NULL)
          OR ("shop_gacha_roll"."chest_kind" = 'topic' AND "shop_gacha_roll"."topic_id" IS NOT NULL))

shop_gacha_roll_frame_check.name: shop_gacha_roll_frame_check
shop_gacha_roll_frame_check.value:
"shop_gacha_roll"."frame_version" > 0 AND length(btrim("shop_gacha_roll"."frame_name")) BETWEEN 1 AND 160
        AND "shop_gacha_roll"."frame_code" ~ '^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$' AND length("shop_gacha_roll"."frame_code") <= 160

shop_gacha_roll_refund_check.name: shop_gacha_roll_refund_check
shop_gacha_roll_refund_check.value:
(NOT "shop_gacha_roll"."duplicate" AND "shop_gacha_roll"."refund" = 0) OR ("shop_gacha_roll"."duplicate" AND "shop_gacha_roll"."refund" =
        CASE "shop_gacha_roll"."rarity" WHEN 'R' THEN 1 WHEN 'SR' THEN 5 WHEN 'SSR' THEN 20 END)

shop_gacha_roll_counters_check.name: shop_gacha_roll_counters_check
shop_gacha_roll_counters_check.value:
"shop_gacha_roll"."roll_sequence" > 0
        AND "shop_gacha_roll"."since_sr_before" BETWEEN 0 AND 9 AND "shop_gacha_roll"."since_ssr_before" BETWEEN 0 AND 49
        AND "shop_gacha_roll"."since_sr_before" <= "shop_gacha_roll"."since_ssr_before" AND "shop_gacha_roll"."since_ssr_before" < "shop_gacha_roll"."roll_sequence"
        AND "shop_gacha_roll"."since_sr_after" BETWEEN 0 AND 9 AND "shop_gacha_roll"."since_ssr_after" BETWEEN 0 AND 49
        AND "shop_gacha_roll"."since_sr_after" <= "shop_gacha_roll"."since_ssr_after"
        AND (("shop_gacha_roll"."rarity" = 'SSR' AND "shop_gacha_roll"."since_sr_after" = 0 AND "shop_gacha_roll"."since_ssr_after" = 0)
          OR ("shop_gacha_roll"."rarity" = 'SR' AND "shop_gacha_roll"."since_sr_after" = 0 AND "shop_gacha_roll"."since_ssr_after" = "shop_gacha_roll"."since_ssr_before" + 1)
          OR ("shop_gacha_roll"."rarity" = 'R' AND "shop_gacha_roll"."since_sr_after" = "shop_gacha_roll"."since_sr_before" + 1 AND "shop_gacha_roll"."since_ssr_after" = "shop_gacha_roll"."since_ssr_before" + 1))

shop_gacha_state_counters_check.name: shop_gacha_state_counters_check
shop_gacha_state_counters_check.value:
"shop_gacha_state"."since_sr" BETWEEN 0 AND 9 AND "shop_gacha_state"."since_ssr" BETWEEN 0 AND 49
        AND "shop_gacha_state"."since_sr" <= "shop_gacha_state"."since_ssr" AND "shop_gacha_state"."roll_count" >= "shop_gacha_state"."since_ssr"

translation_group_profile_delete_metadat.name: translation_group_profile_delete_metadata_check
translation_group_profile_delete_metadat.value: "translation_group_profile"."deleted_at" IS NOT NULL OR ("translation_group_profile"."deleted_by_user_id" IS NULL AND "translation_group_profile"."delete_reason" IS NULL)

user_profile_moderation_check.name: user_profile_moderation_check
user_profile_moderation_check.value: "user_profile"."status" = 'active' OR ("user_profile"."moderated_at" IS NOT NULL AND "user_profile"."moderation_reason" IS NOT NULL)

coin_comment_reward_state_check.name: coin_comment_reward_state_check
coin_comment_reward_state_check.value: "coin_comment_reward"."rewarded_amount" BETWEEN 0 AND 1 AND "coin_comment_reward"."reversal_amount" BETWEEN 0 AND 1 AND "coin_comment_reward"."rewarded_amount" + "coin_comment_reward"."reversal_amount" <= 1 AND "coin_comment_reward"."revision" >= 0

coin_ledger_delta_check.name: coin_ledger_delta_check
coin_ledger_delta_check.value: ("coin_ledger"."mode" = 'credit' AND "coin_ledger"."delta" = "coin_ledger"."requested_amount") OR ("coin_ledger"."mode" = 'debit' AND "coin_ledger"."delta" = -"coin_ledger"."requested_amount") OR ("coin_ledger"."mode" = 'penalty' AND "coin_ledger"."delta" BETWEEN -"coin_ledger"."requested_amount" AND 0)

coin_wallet_remainder_check.name: coin_wallet_remainder_check
coin_wallet_remainder_check.value: "coin_wallet"."view_remainder_tenths" BETWEEN 0 AND 999 AND ("coin_wallet"."group_id" IS NOT NULL OR "coin_wallet"."view_remainder_tenths" = 0)
